title: Settlement binding mapping (People's Court Partner API v2)
description: Output contract for the settlement boundary the adapter derives from an ADAL/1 package's escrowRef + awardSlot. Mirrors the documented settlement-binding surface: a binding names the ALLOWED actions and the authority corpus; an Award does not by itself move money — execution is a separate, credential-scoped step (decision_served never triggers execution without a separately scoped settlement adapter credential). CoreGuard escrow is reference-only in this record.
